notes.title: Join Us for the Women's Day Steam Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]So, This vampire walks into a bar...[/h1]

[h2]--and what happens next?[/h2]  That up to you!  In this visual novel/bartending adventure your skills a bartender will not only decide your paycheck, but could decide the fate of the entire town!

As a women-led studio we are excited to be  part of this event. We'll be showing off new content, answering all your questions and doing live demos for our upcoming release, "So, this Vampire Walks into a bar".  Several play-thrus of our demo will show alternate endings, drink mixing tips and secrets, and discussing the world of Frankie's Lair.  We'll also be dropping hints as to what's coming next in the full release and clues to mysteries behind this strange bar and its patrons.

Now is your chance to chat with devs live, ask questions, give feedback, and even make suggestions for the game.  Cheers!
